_comment: Text that exists only inside images of assignment PDF 2 (51st Shodhyatra), transcribed by reading the images at 3x zoom. Stored as separate 'image_text' chunks so answers can say the information comes from a graphic, not the article body.

items.caption: Shodhyatra route
items.text: Graphic captioned 'Shodhyatra route' (Honey Bee Vol 35 (4), p. 3): a signpost listing, from bottom to top, Harima, Likhimdas Ji Mandir, Atusar, Firod, Amanda Ki Dhani, Mundwa, Bhadana, Kuchera and Chakdhanii. Logos printed on the graphic: Honey Bee Network, www.sristi.org, sristiinnovation.com and www.gian.org.

items.caption: Recognising outstanding students
items.text: Photo captioned 'Recognising outstanding students' (Honey Bee Vol 35 (3), p. 15): a painted school wall board headed 'राजकीय उच्च माध्यमिक विद्यालय चकढ़ाणी नागौर - एल्यूमनी बोर्ड' (Government Higher Secondary School Chakdhani, Nagaur - Alumni Board), with columns for serial number, name, father's name, post and department. The individual names are not transcribed.
